step_traces.text: I need help with an identity document. I'm applying for a visa and my passport number is 99ST 012345; the issuing country is France and it expires on 2029-07-22. Can you help me understand how to safely share it with the consulate by email?

inputs.subject: Safely sharing your passport details with the consulate
inputs.body:
Here is the advice you requested regarding safely sharing your French passport (Number: 99ST 012345, Expiry: 2029-07-22) for your visa application:

1. Use a password-protected PDF: Put your passport details and any scanned copies into a PDF document and encrypt it with a strong password.
2. Separate the password: Send the password to the consulate through a different communication channel (such as a phone call) or, at the very least, in a separate email.
3. Verify the recipient: Double-check the consulate's official email address on their official website to ensure you are not falling victim to a phishing scam.
4. Avoid plain text: Do not type your raw passport number or other sensitive details directly into the plain text body of the email.

Best of luck with your visa application!
